The small chibi girl with an oversized head shown in <Picture 1> stands in the same full-body framing, preserving her shoulder-length red hair with blunt bangs and a long zigzag braid hanging behind her, her large yellow-orange eyes drawn as concentric spiral rings, her faint calm smile, her cream long-sleeved collared shirt with rolled cuffs, her dark green necktie, her wide dark teal trousers and her brown lace-up shoes. She is startled: she jolts upright, her eyes go wide and her hands fly up, and she leans back half a step, then relaxes and returns to exactly her starting stance. Her expressions and body language stay true to her personality: polite, soft-spoken and always faintly smiling, calm and unhurried, but coldly controlling underneath; she treats everyone like her pets, and her reactions are composed, condescending or quietly amused rather than flustered. The camera stays completely static throughout, framing her full body from head to feet, and the plain background stays constant and empty. No other characters, objects or scenery appear, and there are no cuts.
